idea: Painted and stained wood on a pale limewood table. Flat colour only: grain is drawn as ink lines, not rendered.

colours.name: Limewood table
colours.use: Page background (round 2, was walnut #3B2416): pale tabletop planks so the oak tray and cream tiles read as objects on it. Ink text on it: 11.4:1.

colours.name: Walnut
colours.use: Now only an accent: the next opponent's plaque in the lobby. Cream text on it: 12.4:1.

colours.name: Walnut seam
colours.use: Ink: every outline, plank seams, burned lettering, text on light wood. Doubles as the darkest wood.

colours.name: Oak tray
colours.use: The carved board tray, shop shelf, panels. Ink text on it: 5.6:1.

colours.name: Oak carve
colours.use: Recesses (empty slots), tile edge thickness, shelf lips. Cream text on it: 5.0:1.

colours.name: Birch face
colours.use: Tile and card faces, slot-label strips, rules text (round 2: lighter, more cream round the art). Ink text on it: 15.1:1.

colours.name: Cream
colours.use: Text and highlights on dark wood and on painted stat beads.

colours.name: Moss leaf
colours.use: Positive: End turn and Play leaves, 'won' marks, your own name. Cream text on it: 5.7:1.

colours.name: Acorn gold
colours.use: Gold (acorns), costs. Ink text on it: 7.4:1.

colours.name: Thorn ochre
colours.use: Attack: the hexagonal nut, the light stat (luminance 0.46). Ink numeral on it: 8.1:1.

colours.name: Rosehip red
colours.use: Health: the round rosehip with a green crown, the dark stat (luminance 0.10); also negative and the next-opponent ring. Cream numeral on it: 6.1:1.

colours.name: Nightshade
colours.use: The Nightshade status: painted berry ring, keyword text, halving callout. Cream text on it: 7.4:1.

colours.name: Frost glaze
colours.use: Frozen shop offers and the Freeze leaf. Ink text on it: 10.5:1.

colours.name: Gilt
colours.use: Golden units: gold-leaf tile face and brass edge. Ink text on it: 9.9:1.

colours.name: Pine token
colours.use: Created units (tokens): pale unvarnished pine with a dashed burned edge. Ink text on it: 13.4:1.

colours.name: Rime blue
colours.use: Frozen: the outer frost rim and icicle outlines. Not used for text.

colours.name: Burned label
colours.use: Secondary text: tribe lines, captions, legend headings. On limewood 6.9:1, on cream 9.2:1.

contrast_checked: WCAG AA (4.5:1) for every text pairing listed, with the WCAG relative-luminance formula. Attack and Health differ in luminance by about 4.6 times, so they separate in greyscale as well as by shape.
